nom: RoC Retinol Line Smoothing Anti Wrinkle for Dark Circles Eye Cream

segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin generally report the cream is tolerated without redness or itching, though a few report allergic reactions, milia, or bumpy skin at first use.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s-50s report smoothing of fine lines and crow's feet with consistent long-term use, some over a year or more.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry under-eye skin report the cream relieves dryness and flakiness, though one reported eyes felt drier and irritated after use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visible softening or disappearance of fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes, often after several weeks to months of use; a few report no noticeable change even after finishing a full tube.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the cream keeps the under-eye area hydrated and moist, including one with very dry under-eyes; one reviewer reports the opposite, with dryness and flaking that later resolved.
concerns.redness: One reviewer developed redness, swelling, and flakiness on the eyelid from misuse (applying on the lid rather than under the eye); most other reviewers report no redness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention initial flaking, small bumps, or dryness during the first days of use that later subsided, suggesting a short adjustment period for some.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for milia report mixed results: one says it is the only eye cream that did not give her milia, another reports milia clearing up after a month, while one reviewer developed milia clusters from this product.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the cream caused pimples around the eye area; this is not mentioned elsewhere.

aspects.libelle: No noticeable results for some users

extraits.texte: Doesnt do anything my regular moisturizer doesnt do. Its really expensive just for something that provides moisture to my under eyes (which my moisturizer already does). Havent noticed any other positive results other than moisturization. Also, it resulted in clusters of milia on both my undereyes. Wont be repurchasing.

I've been using this product for over a year, but recently have developed redness, irritation, swelling, flakiness primarily on left eyelid. I stopped all products, except ROC Eye cream which says to apply AROUND the eyes. After extensive research, I read retinol on eyelids is a NO NO, even ROC's eye retinol. It should only be applied under the eye. Shouldn't ROC state this on their product and website?

Another great RoC product my very sensitive skin tolerates without any problems and has done wonders for wrinkles around my eyes and it definitely brightens up my eyes so I guess I had dark circles and didn't know it! Great Retinol Eye Cream!!

extraits.titre: The only eye cream that didn't give me milia
extraits.texte: I could not use eye creams because I would always get milia around my eyes. I've tried multiple types of eye creams. Now that I'm in my thirties I'm noticeing more dryness and fine lines around my eyes and I need eye cream and I finally think I found an eye cream that not only helps with dryness and fine lines but also doesnt give me milia. I will be using this till I die now. You only need a little and I also use a little bit for my laugh lines and it helps that too.
This is a great eye cream. My skin is very sensitive and this product is that. My under eyes looks more bright and smooth. It takes only a little but works great.

Loved this! this is the first retinol eye cream i've used and although i can't speak yet on long term results, it's kept my (super dry) undereyes hydrated all day and i feel like it's helping keeping the fine lines smoother, so i'll keep being constant with it but for now, 10/10

I have been using RoC eye creams twice a day for over 10 years and tried the RoC retinol correction line smoothing eye cream just last year. I absolutely love it and have been using it daily ever since then. Not only has it turned the clock back on my fine lines, but it has also improved my skin so much that my makeup doesn't look cakey under my eyes any more. I saw results in just a couple of months. It is easy to apply and absorbs quickly. The smooth texture leaves my eye area feeling smooth and nourished. This is the best retinol eye cream I've found on the market. The quality compares to high end creams, without the high price. I can honestly say adding this product to my skincare routine has given me the confidence to go makeup free more often because now I don't have fine lines to hide. I credit this eye cream for giving me an eye age 15 years younger than my real age when I used the AI skin analysis.
